chunks: And indeed, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What are the two main attributes of God mentioned in Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to Prophet Muhammad amidst the ridicule of the Quraysh, affirming that the ultimate arbiter of truth is both sovereign in power and compassionate in mercy. Shia exegetes often highlight this duality as a model for leadership, where authority is exercised with benevolence, reflecting the balance between justice (Adl) and grace (Lutf).
